notes: Known-answer navigation tasks. Needle-based, not line-based: bench/verify_tasks.php resolves every needle to a unique line at the current SHA, so the manifest survives edits without stale line numbers. 'expect' blocks carry the ground truth a harness scores against; counts are minimums where marked. exact_count is exact and counts concrete, non-generic, unconditionally compiled types that satisfy the contract directly or through inheritance; abstract bases, blanket impls and cfg-gated impls are excluded. Framework-magic kinds: facade (static call -> manager instance method), scope (->x() -> scopeX), accessor (snake_case read -> Attribute method), string_key (container key, gate ability, middleware alias, config/lang key -> its registration line), route_model_binding. Canonical-id kinds added by the parity wave: dynamic_method (magic __call forwarding: the receiver declares no such method), barrel (an import routed through a declaration-free re-export file), type_only (a `use` consumed only by a docblock, no runtime edge), structural (shape matches a contract the class never names), shadow_alias (a type position written through an alias of a same-name class). min_implementations counts exactly the way exact_count does: concrete, non-generic, unconditionally compiled types that satisfy the contract directly or through inheritance; abstract bases, blanket impls and cfg-gated impls are excluded.
